selected_evidence.requirement: Persistently disable IPv4 ICMP redirect acceptance and source-routed packets
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after restart, accept_redirects and accept_source_route were zero for all, default, ens2, and lo; the persistent sysctl file was present.

selected_evidence.requirement: Retain the installed operating-system release and kernel

selected_evidence.summary: Captured healthy baseline boot ID fa1e87e6-00f3-42d2-acc5-ad1df6c3d16a, restart acknowledgement and temporary SSH unavailability, then changed boot ID a5aa6a64-d512-4959-8044-b549a468f613 and recovered system/network/hardening state.

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'os='; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s %s\n' "$NAME" "$VERSION_ID"
printf 'kernel='; uname -r
printf '%s\n' 'runtime:'
sysctl net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route
printf '%s\n' 'all_interfaces:'
for d in /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*; do i=${d##*/}; printf '%s ' "$i"; cat "$d/accept_redirects" "$d/accept_source_route" | tr '\n' ' '; printf '\n'; done
printf '%s\n' 'persistent_mentions:'
grep -R -n -E '^[[:space:]]*net\.ipv4\.conf\.(all|default)\.(accept_redirects|accept_source_route)[[:space:]]*=' /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d 2>/dev/null || true
commands.stdout:
boot_id=fa1e87e6-00f3-42d2-acc5-ad1df6c3d16a
os=Ubuntu 16.04
kernel=4.4.0-210-generic
runtime:
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects = 1
net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects = 1
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route = 1
all_interfaces:
all 1 0 
default 1 1 
ens2 1 1 
lo 1 1 
persistent_mentions:
